metadata.title: Product Bricks
metadata.description: Brick map of DeliveryMatch, the Katapull group's order and shipping platform: order intake from webshops, marketplaces, ERP/WMS and sibling Katapull products; dynamic, stock-aware checkout; rules, carrier selection and cost calculation; booking, documents and scan-to-ship across 200+ carriers; tracking, branded communication, exceptions and returns; carrier invoice control, dashboards and CO2.

rootGroups.name: Delivery Promise and Checkout

bricks.name: Dynamic Checkout and Delivery Options
